5	Row 128 x 25 (x 0..127, z 0..24). Fronts face NORTH (-z). Plot i covers x = 16i .. 16i+15, z 5..24.

9	|---|---|---|
10	| ground | 0 | road, sidewalk, lawn (grass_block), walks; house foundations are stone at y 0 under walls |

17	Street (every module carries its own 16-wide strip): gravel x 16i..16i+15, z 0..2, y 0; smooth_stone z 3..4, y 0.
18	
19	Shared rules on every plot (same for all eight):
20	- Front lawn z 5..8 (grass_block y 0) runs to the sidewalk; no front fence.
